name: Sofia Vargas
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after she completed her engineering degree in Medellín. Volunteering at a local racing team to gain practical experience, she quickly discovered a passion for the intricate mechanics and precision required to build and maintain high-performance racing cars. Her natural aptitude for problem-solving and meticulous attention to detail led her to specialize in fabrication. 

Sofia is known for her relentless pursuit of perfection and her ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues under pressure. At Elite Motorsport, she approaches every project with a blend of technical expertise and creative thinking, always striving to improve the performance and reliability of the team's vehicles. Her experience makes her a valuable asset in high-stakes environments.

physical.hairStyle: long, braided, often tied back with a colorful scarf
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a lean, athletic build and a focused look.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a collection of miniature race car models on her workbench.
Listens to salsa music while working to maintain focus and energy.
